resources.string: Uploads only locally detected, settled INR transaction SMS messages to your private budget endpoint.

I consent to this app reading every inbox SMS from the current India-time month on each sync. Filtering happens on the phone, and only likely settled financial transactions with an INR amount are uploaded. OTP/authentication, promotions, balances, due notices, self-transfers, card-bill confirmations, order-status-only messages, and ordinary personal messages are excluded. Uploaded fields are a redacted sender, timestamp, and redacted SMS body. A count-only completion checkpoint proves the full monthly scan finished. Permission can be revoked in Android Settings.
Shared HMAC secret (leave blank to keep saved secret)
